## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, the old behavior, and what this change does.

## Validation

List the commands or checks actually run and their outcomes. Include a regression case for a behavior change. Clearly identify anything not tested.

## Compatibility and limitations

Mention changes to CLI options, JSON outputs, rule semantics, persisted state, or dependency requirements. Delete this section if none apply.

## Review checklist

- [ ] I reviewed and understand the code, including any AI-assisted changes.
- [ ] Tests and documentation match the final behavior.
- [ ] Fixtures are synthetic and contain no private data or credentials.
- [ ] Retry/revision loops remain bounded, if affected.
